# Processes represented in the grammar both ways

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`processes-represented-both-ways` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](processes-represented-both-ways.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A process is exactly its relations, one per move, so a law over processes holds of all relations indexed by moves; every relation is a process's steps. With the move inside, a correspondence carrying the steps and both classes is a renaming, which keeps the bridged notions; one class is not enough.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A process is exactly its relations, one per move: they are read back from it and make it, by definition, and its steps are their union. A process with one move steps by its one relation, so every relation is the steps of the one-move process of its edges, a process with its moves forgotten has the same steps, and a determined law's steps are its step relation; enabledness is «能» at a move's relation. (`Becoming.moveRel_mk`, `Becoming.mk_moveRel`, `Becoming.steps_iff_moveRel`, `Becoming.steps_one_move`, `Becoming.steps_edgeProcess`, `Becoming.steps_unlabelled`, `Becoming.steps_lawProcess`, `Becoming.enabled_iff_neng`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
2. A law's truth is carried: a property of relations shared by relations alike pointwise (a hypothesis from the core's logic, not the property's content) holds of every process's steps exactly where of every relation, and one of relations indexed by moves of every process's exactly where of all such. A statement naming a process notion is in the grammar's terms only through its bridge. (`Becoming.forall_steps_iff`, `Becoming.forall_moveRel_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
3. The converse: every class is the class of a frame's claims, likeness to depth zero. The model with the move inside recovers the process on its fixed carrier, and its image is exactly the relations leaving the next move open, so the relation 'the next move is true' is no process's model. (`Becoming.class_is_claims`, `Becoming.step_iff_withMove`, `Becoming.withMove_image_iff`, `Becoming.reading_next_move_not_withMove`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
4. Faithful up to correspondence with both classes, the sameness of each coordinate: a renaming relating two processes is a correspondence of their models with the move inside carrying the steps and both classes, and from a configuration and a move every such correspondence is the product of a renaming relating them. With no move, or no configuration, the point is needed: the empty models correspond, yet one is not two. (`Becoming.withMove_of_renaming`, `Becoming.configurationRenaming`, `Becoming.moveRenaming`, `Becoming.renaming_of_withMove`, `Becoming.NoMoves.P`, `Becoming.NoMoves.P'`, `Becoming.NoMoves.e`, `Becoming.NoMoves.models_correspond`, `Becoming.NoMoves.not_renamed`, `Becoming.NoConfigurations.P`, `Becoming.NoConfigurations.P'`, `Becoming.NoConfigurations.e`, `Becoming.NoConfigurations.models_correspond`, `Becoming.NoConfigurations.not_renamed`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
5. Neither class alone: the twist flips the configuration where the move is true and keeps the class of the same move, the flip flips the move where the configuration is true and keeps the class of the same configuration, and each carries the model of one process to that of another which no renaming of configurations and moves relates to it. (`Becoming.Twist.P₁`, `Becoming.Twist.P₂`, `Becoming.Twist.flipConfiguration`, `Becoming.Twist.flipConfiguration_twice`, `Becoming.Twist.e`, `Becoming.Twist.steps_carried`, `Becoming.Twist.models_correspond`, `Becoming.Twist.P₂_not_both`, `Becoming.Twist.P₂_loops_by_one_move`, `Becoming.Twist.not_renamed`, `Becoming.Flip.P₃`, `Becoming.Flip.P₄`, `Becoming.Flip.flipMove`, `Becoming.Flip.flipMove_twice`, `Becoming.Flip.e`, `Becoming.Flip.steps_carried`, `Becoming.Flip.models_correspond`, `Becoming.Flip.P₄_apart`, `Becoming.Flip.not_renamed`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
6. A renaming relating two processes carries each move's relation and the steps, so through the bridges and the grammar's terms kept by correspondence it keeps traces, the word renamed letter by letter, n steps and within n steps, reach, returning and invariants, determination and merging nothing, going alike under a description read back, and going on along some branch. (`Becoming.renaming_moveRel`, `Becoming.renaming_steps`, `Becoming.renaming_trace`, `Becoming.renaming_iterate`, `Becoming.renaming_reach`, `Becoming.renaming_returns`, `Becoming.renaming_invariant`, `Becoming.renaming_determined`, `Becoming.renaming_lossless`, `Becoming.renaming_goAlike`, `Becoming.renaming_yan`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure, finite runs and lumping; its declarations reach the grammar.
7. Forward: a trace is passing through the moves' relations along its word («历»), and a word is feasible exactly where that leads somewhere. A process factors through a map exactly where each move's image lies within the other's (Mechanism's image, move by move); a run's configurations carry the line of steps into the steps, and with the move inside a run is exactly a sequence along which that image lies within. (`Becoming.trace_iff_li`, `Becoming.feasible_iff_li`, `Becoming.factorsThrough_iff_image`, `Becoming.run_image`, `Becoming.run_iff_image`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
8. Going on along some branch of the steps («延») is lying in a family that keeps moving, and a run goes on from where it starts. On relations on a type of the first universe, going on gives a line exactly under dependent choice, read from Onward's calibration; within finitely many configurations it gives one with nothing chosen. (`Becoming.yan_iff_keepsMoving`, `Becoming.run_yan`, `Becoming.yan_line_iff_dependentChoice`, `Becoming.yan_line_of_list`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* finite runs; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
9. The steps forget the moves: on one configuration with two moves, the process stepping only by true and the one stepping only by false have the same steps, and only the first is enabled by true. (`Becoming.Forgotten.byTrue`, `Becoming.Forgotten.byFalse`, `Becoming.Forgotten.moves_forgotten`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
10. Along any map: it preserves a relation exactly where the image of the relation along it lies within the other («保之像»), and going on along some branch reflects along any map lifting continuation, with no inverse («延之拉回»). (`Becoming.«保之像»`, `Becoming.«延之拉回»`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
11. Correspondences compose side by side («一一对应».prod), and the terms the renamings read are kept by a correspondence carrying what they read: passing through a word with its letters renamed, n steps its case; within n steps; a closed region where membership is carried; a fixed successor and predecessor; going alike; and going on along some branch, two cases of its pulling back. (`Becoming.«一一对应».prod`, `Becoming.GrammarTransport.map_replicate`, `Becoming.«历之像»`, `Becoming.«历之对应»`, `Becoming.«迭之像»`, `Becoming.«迭之对应»`, `Becoming.«迭内之对应»`, `Becoming.«闭之对应»`, `Becoming.«定后之对应»`, `Becoming.«定前之对应»`, `Becoming.«同行之对应»`, `Becoming.«延之对应»`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The process model's commitments: configurations and moves as types, Prop-valued steps, discrete runs indexed by the natural numbers; a process is read only through its steps, so what a statement reads beyond them is outside the reading.
- Faithfulness up to correspondence is for the model with the move inside, on configurations paired with moves, with the classes of the same move and the same configuration carried, from a configuration and a move given.
- The calibration is for relations on types of the first universe, as Onward's dependent choice is; the forward bridges are notion by notion, for the notions listed.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That a statement over processes is in the grammar's terms: its truth is carried, but a statement naming an unbridged process notion (likeness by bisimulation, stretch orders, branching tests and others) stays with its model.
- That every functional total relation is a determined law's step: that is unique choice on one carrier, which the core does not assume.
- A product and its factors as one construction: the grammar relates the three carriers only through maps, forming no pairing.
- That a sequence whose image lies within the steps is a run's configurations: a move chosen at each step is countable choice, not assumed; with the move inside it is a run, and nothing is chosen.
- A line from going on along some branch beyond finitely many configurations without dependent choice.
- The theorems that read no field of the old base and are about other structures than processes (optima, weightings, regime margins and the rest), which this reading does not reach.
- A forward theorem: no statement says every process notion is a grammar term; correspondence lemmas for the grammar's terms not listed in GrammarTransport.
- Morphisms of models beyond correspondences, the functor question 55 of the logic dossier asks for; and the design's counting remarks (fewer relations than processes on a finite carrier), which are not in Lean.
- **Counterexample:** The twist: P₁ steps exactly from true, P₂ by true from false and by false from true; flipping the configuration where the move is true carries one model to the other with the class of the same move, and no renaming relates them (Twist.models_correspond, Twist.not_renamed). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ProcessRepresentation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The flip: P₃ steps by true everywhere, P₄ by false at true and by true at false; flipping the move where the configuration is true carries one model to the other with the class of the same configuration, and no renaming relates them (Flip.models_correspond, Flip.not_renamed). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ProcessRepresentation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** With no move, the models of a process on one configuration and of one on two are both empty and correspond, and no renaming relates them (NoMoves.models_correspond, NoMoves.not_renamed); with no configuration, likewise for one move and two (NoConfigurations.not_renamed). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ProcessRepresentation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** On one configuration, stepping only by true and only by false give the same steps, and only the first is enabled by true (Forgotten.moves_forgotten); a relation reading the next move is no process's model (reading_next_move_not_withMove). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ProcessRepresentation.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Pure core, every axiom report empty: ProcessRepresentation imports EdgeClosure, GrammarTransport, Labelled, Onward, GrammarRegularity and GrammarCandidates, and with GrammarLaws and GrammarTransport extended the whole package compiles with no name clash. Every result is pointwise; the core's List.reverse_cons reports propext, so the list lemmas «历» needs are proved by induction. The witnesses are single small processes.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

A process is a labelled transition system, and its moves' relations are its labelled transition relations; the model with the move inside is the system read on states paired with labels. That a correspondence of such models respecting both coordinates is a pair of renamings is the elementary fact that a bijection of a product preserving both projection kernels is a product of bijections. A trace as the composite along its word is the relational semantics of words (the transition monoid); a line from going on is dependent choice (Onward's calibration). Graded in WRP's DESIGN.md.
